name: Afghanistan (Kingdom, 1929–1931)
description: Three vertical stripes of black, red and green with a white emblem on the red stripe: a mosque within a rayed sun-like star.
history: Flag adopted after Mohammed Nadir Shah took Kabul from the Saqqawist rebels in October 1929 and restored the monarchy, returning to the vertical black, red and green tricolour with the mosque emblem set in rays. It was replaced on 27 March 1931 by the version with a wheat wreath and the year 1348 that served the kingdom until 1973.
